arxiv-1602-07965.title: On Subgroups of Topologized Fundamental Groups and Generalized Coverings
arxiv-1602-07965.creator: Mehdi Abdullahi Rashid, Behrooz Mashayekhy, Hamid Torabi, Seyyed Zeynal Pashaei
arxiv-1602-07965.description: Abstract In this paper, we are interested in study subgroups of topologized fundamental groups and their influences on generalized covering maps. More precisely, we find some relationships between generalized covering subgroups and the other famous subgroups of the fundamental group equipped with the compact-open topology and the whisker topology.

arxiv-2107-04354.title: A Bayesian Semiparametric Vector Multiplicative Error Model
arxiv-2107-04354.creator: Nicola Donelli, Stefano Peluso, Antonietta Mira
arxiv-2107-04354.description: Abstract Interactions among multiple time series of positive random variables are crucial in diverse financial applications, from spillover effects to volatility interdependence. A popular model in this setting is the vector Multiplicative Error Model (vMEM) which poses a linear iterative structure on the dynamics of the conditional mean, perturbed by a multiplicative innovation term.

arxiv-2206-04073.title: SO(4) multicriticality of two-dimensional Dirac fermions
arxiv-2206-04073.creator: Igor F. Herbut, Michael M. Scherer
arxiv-2206-04073.description: Abstract We study quantum multicritical behavior in a (2+1)-dimensional Gross-Neveu-Yukawa field theory with eight-component Dirac fermions coupled to two triplets of order parameters that act as Dirac masses, and transform as ( 1 , 0 ) + ( 0 , 1 ) (1,0)+(0,1) representation under the SO(4) ≃ \simeq SO(3) × \times SO(3) symmetry group.

arxiv-2212-06821.title: Surpassing spectator qubits with photonic modes and continuous measurement for Heisenberg-limited noise mitigation
arxiv-2212-06821.creator: Andrew Lingenfelter 1,2∗ and Aashish A. Clerk
arxiv-2212-06821.description: Abstract Noise is an ever-present challenge to the creation and preservation of fragile quantum states. Recent work suggests that spatial noise correlations can be harnessed as a resource for noise mitigation via the use of spectator qubits to measure environmental noise.

arxiv-2301-11165.title: Timing performances of front-end electronics with 3D-trench silicon sensors
arxiv-2301-11165.creator: and Adriano Lai
arxiv-2301-11165.description: Abstract Detectors based on pixels with timing capabilities are gaining increasing importance in the last years. Next-to-come high-energy physics experiments at colliders require the use of time information in tracking, due to the expected levels of track densities in the foreseen experimental conditions.

arxiv-2403-05244.title: Multipartite entanglement in the diagonal symmetric subspace
arxiv-2403-05244.creator: Jordi Romero-Pallejà, Jennifer Ahiable, Alessandro Romancino, Carlo Marconi, Anna Sanpera
arxiv-2403-05244.description: Abstract We investigate the entanglement properties in the symmetric subspace of N N -partite d d -dimensional systems (qudits). As it happens already for bipartite diagonal symmetric states, also in the multipartite case the local dimension d d plays a crucial role.

arxiv-2409-12299.title: Understanding Web Application Workloads and Their Applications: Systematic Literature Review and Characterization
arxiv-2409-12299.creator: Roozbeh Aghili, Qiaolin Qin, Heng Li, Foutse Khomh
arxiv-2409-12299.description: Abstract Web applications, accessible via web browsers over the Internet, facilitate complex functionalities without local software installation. In the context of web applications, a workload refers to the number of user requests sent by users or applications to the underlying system. Existing studies have leveraged web application workloads to achieve various objectives, such as workload prediction and auto-scaling.

pmc-10533487.title: Cortical excitability and multifidus activation responses to transcranial direct current stimulation in patients with chronic low back pain during remission
pmc-10533487.creator: Peemongkon Wattananon, Khin Win Thu, Soniya Maharjan, Kanphajee Sornkaew, Hsing-Kuo Wang
pmc-10533487.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Evidence indicates that patients with chronic low back pain (CLBP) have lumbar multifidus muscle (LM) activation deficit which might be caused by changes in cortical excitability. Anodal transcranial direct current stimulation (a-tDCS) can be used to restore cortical excitability. This study aimed to (1) determine the immediate effects of a-tDCS on the cortical excitability and LM activation and (2) explore the relationship between cortical excitability and LM activation. Thirteen participants with CLBP during remission and 11 healthy participants were recruited.

pmc-11521719.title: Hurdle technology using enzymes and essential oil to remove biofilm and increase the effectiveness of this process with the microencapsulation method
pmc-11521719.creator: Ayda Ghahari, Kianoush Khosravi‐Darani
pmc-11521719.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The formation of biofilm in different places and the failure to effectively remove it by the usual disinfection methods is due to its structure and the rich genetic resource available in it to deal with disinfectants. These impenetrable structures and diverse microbial genetics have caused biofilm pollution in different industries like the food industry, the medicine industry, the hospitals and the water distribution system, resulting in pathogenicity and reduction of industrial quality.

pmc-11568785.title: Comparative evaluation of the degree of conversion of an 8th-generation bonding agent when applied to normal dentin or caries-affected dentin, pre-treated with MMP inhibitors – An in vitro study
pmc-11568785.creator: Neil Vincent Lewis, Shalini Aggarwal, Prasanna Dhatavkar
pmc-11568785.description: IntroductionThe degree of conversion of dentin bonding agents contributes to the success of final restorations in adhesive dentistry. It is clinically relevant, as it is directly related to the overall bond strength that maintains these restorations in place and prevents marginal deterioration.

pmc-11632116.title: The impacts of hospital admission in very late‐onset schizophrenia‐like psychosis: A case report
pmc-11632116.creator: Shigeki Katakami, Yuto Satake, Takashi Suehiro, Daiki Ishimaru, Erina Nakanishi, Hideki Kanemoto, Kenji Yoshiyama, Manabu Ikeda
pmc-11632116.description: BackgroundVery late‐onset schizophrenia‐like psychosis (VLOSLP) is a psychotic disorder with an age of onset ≥60 years, and social isolation is a risk factor. pmc-11714443.title: APOE ε4 genotype confers risk for Alzheimer Disease in Cuban Americans
pmc-11714443.creator: Jose Javier Sanchez, Bilcag Akgun, Kara L Hamilton‐Nelson, Joe Rivero, Katrina Celis, Larry D Adams, Glenies S Valladares, Concepcion Silva‐Vergara, Vanessa C Rodriguez, Pedro R Mena, Patrice L Whitehead, Michael B Prough, Anthony J Griswold, Clifton L Dalgard, Katalina F McInerney, Jeffery M Vance,
pmc-11714443.description: BackgroundThe risk of Alzheimer Disease (AD) conferred by APOE and other genetic factors differ across populations. The Cuban American (CA) population is 3‐way admixed (European, African, and Amerindian) and vastly underrepresented in genetic studies. Previous genetic studies in this population have solely focused on APOE in AD and shown conflicting results regarding its effects.
